# Initializer Release Notes

Purpose: List significant changes made to this enabler.

## 2026-05-15 (Version 1.0.3)

Summary:
- Consolidated owner changes completed after Version 1.0.2 and finalized into a distribution artifact.

Sections Updated:
- .github/initializer/packs/root/.github/initializer/tools/finalize-distribution.js

Distribution Artifact:
- ai-unified-enabler-v1.0.3.zip

High-Level Behavior:
- Includes all managed source changes accumulated since the previous distribution baseline.
- Closes the active owner work cycle and establishes a new distribution baseline.

Follow-up:
- Start the next cycle by updating managed source files; owner-loop will auto-open the next version when divergence begins.
